name: Brainrot Claw Machine
desc:
🎡 Roblox Claw Machine – Grab, Collect, Evolve! 🍬✨

🕹️ How to Play
🎯 Use powerful claw machines to grab all kinds of brainrots!
🏠 Bring them back to your personal base to earn money.
🍭 Farm candies to feed, evolve, and level up your brainrots into rare and powerful versions!
🌟 Keep collecting to complete your collection and unlock ultra-rare brainrots that only true pros can get.

NEW: Collect mutated brainrots from the personal claw machine (Gold, Diamond, Rainbow, Radioactive).

UPDATES every week! Don't forget to like & favorite the game!
